claim.supported_scope: Recipe-v4 raw continuous single-group reflective CFA with listwise deletion, 500 through 10,000 indexed no-retry full-ML case refits, fixed 95 percent inference, percentile Type-7 plus bounded analytic-studentized Type-7 or BCa Type-7 sidecars.
claim.estimand: The conditional empirical distribution of each supported exact-CFA free-parameter estimate across the usable members of one preplanned case-resampling ledger, with every attempted, usable, and failed indexed refit retained and the selected interval arithmetic identified explicitly.
assumptions: Rows are independent sampling units and the listwise-complete sampling frame is bound to the persisted dataset fingerprint and recipe.
The exact point fit is identified, converged, finite, and admissible under the frozen Recipe-v4 ML estimator.
Analytic-studentized and BCa requests satisfy the complete-case, variable, parameter, optimizer-dimension, worker, and two-sided bounds documented for their immutable sidecars.
exclusions: Recursive structural SEM bootstrap, multigroup, ordinal/WLSMV, robust, FIML, weighted, clustered, multilevel, parametric, and Bollen-Stine bootstrap are outside this identity.
Historical schema-3 cbsem_bootstrap_v2 and analytical cbsem_bootstrap_v1 remain readable but are not current evidence and are never relabeled.
Unsigned local archives do not provide trusted-origin authentication or detection of a malicious coordinated semantic rewrite that replaces every dependent value and unkeyed checksum.
warnings: Inference is conditional on admissible refits; all failed refits remain visible and can make inference typed unavailable.
BCa is complete-only: one failed delete-one fit makes the BCa sidecar globally unavailable rather than silently dropping a case.

Method-level offline qualification requires zero external QuickPLS application/page requests; sampled Microsoft-managed WebView2 background egress is recorded separately and does not satisfy the pending commercial zero-process-egress gate.

equations.expression: CI(theta) = [theta_hat - Q_0.975(t_star) SE_hat, theta_hat - Q_0.025(t_star) SE_hat]

references.citation: Efron (1979), Bootstrap Methods: Another Look at the Jackknife, Annals of Statistics 7(1)
Davison and Hinkley (1997), Bootstrap Methods and Their Application
Efron (1987), Better Bootstrap Confidence Intervals, JASA 82(397)
Frozen standard-library Type-7, reverse-pivot studentized, BCa, indexed-accounting, and metamorphic microfixture

simulations.design: One frozen supplied-ledger microfixture checks interval arithmetic, index restoration, attempted/usable/failed accounting, and explicit unsigned-integrity limits; it does not estimate coverage or rerun the ML estimator.
simulations.seed_policy: No stochastic generation; all point, outer, standard-error, delete-one, status, and index values are frozen literals.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Every frozen binary64 result and boundary boolean must match exactly; the report must explicitly retain the coordinated-rewrite authentication exclusion.

boundaries.case: A primary refit is singular, nonconvergent, nonfinite, inadmissible, or the usable threshold is not reached.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The index and typed failure remain in the ledger, no replacement draw is made, counts remain exact, and below-threshold inference is typed unavailable.

boundaries.case: Input is not raw/listwise CFA or a bounded sidecar exceeds N, V, P, D, worker, confidence, or tail limits.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Preflight and the native compiler fail closed before a result is committed.

boundaries.case: A successful ledger is partitioned or presented in a different processing order and then restored by its exact index.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped percentile, studentized, BCa, standard-error, and accounting results are unchanged.

boundaries.case: The same Recipe-v4 identity and dataset fingerprint execute repeatedly with supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The indexed analytical payload is worker invariant and a cancelled run commits nothing; retry reproduces uninterrupted output.

boundaries.case: Identity, fingerprint, counts, ledger, derived interval, or checksum is altered partially; or every semantic value and unkeyed checksum is maliciously rewritten coherently.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Partial or structurally inconsistent changes are rejected. Trusted-origin authentication and malicious coordinated semantic-rewrite detection are explicitly not claimed.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a point-cell or historical bootstrap payload presented as the current exact-bootstrap cell.
Reject altered base or interval-sidecar method identities and never relabel v1/v2 history.
Reject a result whose bound sampling frame and dataset fingerprint differ.
Reject partial changes whose recipe, model, plan, ledger, canonical-document, or archive digests no longer agree; do not overclaim keyed authentication.
Reject unknown or duplicate fields, nonfinite arithmetic, duplicate/missing indices, inconsistent counts, invalid probabilities, and altered derived intervals.
Keep cbsem_bootstrap_v1 and schema-3 cbsem_bootstrap_v2 readable under their historical identities but non-appendable as current exact evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: Historical cbsem_bootstrap_v1 and cbsem_bootstrap_v2 deserialize and display under their original identities; only Recipe-v4 exact-CFA bootstrap with the registered current cell is promotional.

setup_controls: Percentile, analytic studentized, or BCa interval
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: The current desktop request, native compiler, runner, canonical document, and CLI-compatible Recipe-v4 execution must bind the same exact capability cell and indexed analytical payload for the same recipe and dataset fingerprint.
accessibility_rules: Every interval, count, warning, and unavailable reason has an accessible text/table representation.
Bootstrap status is not communicated by color alone and all setup controls have programmatic labels.
